title.en: Parts and hormones of the pituitary

body.en: The pituitary gland lies in a bony cavity called the sella tursica and is attached to the hypothalamus by a stalk. It is divided into the adenohypophysis and the neurohypophysis. The adenohypophysis has two portions, the pars distalis and the pars intermedia. The pars distalis, commonly called the anterior pituitary, produces growth hormone (GH), prolactin (PRL), thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH), adrenocorticotrophic hormone (ACTH), luteinizing hormone (LH) and follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH). The pars intermedia secretes only melanocyte-stimulating hormone (MSH); in humans it is almost merged with the pars distalis. The neurohypophysis (pars nervosa), the posterior pituitary, stores and releases two hormones, oxytocin and vasopressin, which are actually synthesised by the hypothalamus and transported axonally to it.
body.kn: ಪಿಟ್ಯುಟರಿ ಸೆಲ್ಲಾ ಟರ್ಸಿಕಾ ಎಂಬ ಮೂಳೆ ಕುಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ಮುಂಭಾಗದ ಪಿಟ್ಯುಟರಿ (ಪಾರ್ಸ್ ಡಿಸ್ಟಾಲಿಸ್) GH, PRL, TSH, ACTH, LH ಮತ್ತು FSH ಉತ್ಪಾದಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪಾರ್ಸ್ ಇಂಟರ್ಮೀಡಿಯಾ MSH ಸ್ರವಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಹಿಂಭಾಗದ ಪಿಟ್ಯುಟರಿ ಹೈಪೋಥಲಾಮಸ್ ತಯಾರಿಸಿದ ಆಕ್ಸಿಟೋಸಿನ್ ಮತ್ತು ವ್ಯಾಸೋಪ್ರೆಸಿನ್ ಅನ್ನು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: The pituitary hangs from the hypothalamus by a stalk and sits in a bony cup, the sella tursica. It has an anterior and a posterior part.
The anterior pituitary makes six hormones. The pars intermedia makes only MSH. The posterior pituitary only stores and releases oxytocin and vasopressin, which the hypothalamus makes.

text.en: GH, PRL, TSH, ACTH, LH, FSH

say.en: Each anterior hormone has a target: TSH to the thyroid, ACTH to the adrenal cortex, LH and FSH to the gonads, prolactin to the mammary glands.
Growth hormone disorders depend on age, and lack of ADH causes diabetes insipidus. The pineal gland makes melatonin for our 24-hour rhythm.

explanation.en: The neurohypophysis only stores and releases oxytocin and vasopressin; they are made by the hypothalamus. Melatonin from the pineal helps regulate the 24-hour (diurnal) rhythm.

body.en: Over-secretion of GH stimulates abnormal growth of the body, leading to gigantism, and low secretion of GH results in stunted growth, pituitary dwarfism. Excess secretion of GH in adults, especially in middle age, can cause severe disfigurement, especially of the face, called acromegaly. Prolactin regulates the growth of the mammary glands and formation of milk in them. TSH stimulates the synthesis and secretion of thyroid hormones. ACTH stimulates the synthesis and secretion of glucocorticoids from the adrenal cortex. LH and FSH (gonadotrophins) stimulate gonadal activity. In males, LH stimulates the synthesis and secretion of androgens from the testis, and FSH and androgens regulate spermatogenesis. In females, LH induces ovulation of fully mature (Graafian) follicles and maintains the corpus luteum, and FSH stimulates the growth and development of ovarian follicles. MSH acts on the melanocytes and regulates skin pigmentation. Oxytocin stimulates a vigorous contraction of the uterus at childbirth and milk ejection from the mammary gland. Vasopressin stimulates reabsorption of water and electrolytes by the distal tubules, reducing water loss through urine (diuresis), so it is also called antidiuretic hormone (ADH); impairment of its synthesis or release causes diabetes insipidus.
body.kn: GH ಅಧಿಕವಾದರೆ ದೈತ್ಯತೆ, ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾದರೆ ಪಿಟ್ಯುಟರಿ ಕುಬ್ಜತೆ, ವಯಸ್ಕರಲ್ಲಿ ಅಧಿಕವಾದರೆ ಅಕ್ರೋಮೆಗಲಿ. ಪ್ರೊಲ್ಯಾಕ್ಟಿನ್ ಸ್ತನಗ್ರಂಥಿ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹಾಲು ರಚನೆ. LH ಅಂಡೋತ್ಸರ್ಗ ಪ್ರೇರೇಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, FSH ಕೋಶಿಕೆಗಳ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ. ಆಕ್ಸಿಟೋಸಿನ್ ಹೆರಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗರ್ಭಕೋಶ ಸಂಕೋಚನ ಮತ್ತು ಹಾಲು ಹೊರಹೊಮ್ಮುವಿಕೆ. ADH ಕೊರತೆಯಿಂದ ಡಯಾಬಿಟಿಸ್ ಇನ್ಸಿಪಿಡಸ್.

points.en: GH: excess → gigantism (child) or acromegaly (adult); low → pituitary dwarfism
LH: ovulation, corpus luteum; androgens in males

body.en: The pineal gland is located on the dorsal side of the forebrain. It secretes a hormone called melatonin, which plays a very important role in regulating the 24-hour (diurnal) rhythm of our body. For example, it helps maintain the normal rhythms of the sleep–wake cycle and body temperature. Melatonin also influences metabolism, pigmentation, the menstrual cycle and our defence capability.
body.kn: ಪೀನಿಯಲ್ ಗ್ರಂಥಿ ಮುಮ್ಮಿದುಳಿನ ಬೆನ್ನಿನ ಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ಅದು ಮೆಲಟೋನಿನ್ ಸ್ರವಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಇದು 24 ಗಂಟೆಗಳ ದೈನಿಕ ಲಯ, ನಿದ್ರೆ-ಎಚ್ಚರ ಚಕ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ದೇಹದ ಉಷ್ಣತೆಯನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: Three patients: (a) a 12-year-old far taller than normal for his age, (b) a 45-year-old whose jaw, hands and face have slowly enlarged, (c) a person passing very large volumes of dilute urine with normal blood sugar. Name the hormone and condition in each.

steps.en: (a) Over-secretion of growth hormone in childhood causes gigantism.
(b) Excess growth hormone in adults, especially in middle age, causes acromegaly with disfigurement of the face.
(c) Impaired synthesis or release of vasopressin (ADH) reduces water reabsorption — diabetes insipidus. Normal blood sugar rules out diabetes mellitus.

answer.en: (a) GH — gigantism, (b) GH — acromegaly, (c) ADH — diabetes insipidus
